description: Local terminal lane (ADR-0190 D1, #2772): the four PTY commands, for the main window's own webview (label `main`) on the bundled (local) origin only. Scoped by webview, not window, so a child webview added to the main window later does not inherit the grant. No `remote` entry on purpose: a page loaded from the network, or a frame on another origin, must never reach a PTY. shell_contract.rs asks Tauri's resolver for exactly that.
